title.romaji: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
title.native: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～

Media.description:
Kicked out by his family and wandering the streets, an unemployed 34-year-old shut-in thinks he’s hit rock-bottom—just as he’s hit and killed by a speeding truck! Awakening to find himself reborn as an infant in a world of swords and sorcery, but with the memories of his first life intact, Rudeus Greyrat is determined not to repeat his past mistakes. He’s going to make the most of this reincarnation as he sets off on the adventure of a second lifetime!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: เกิดชาตินี้พี่ต้องเทพ
Mushoku Tensei: In dieser Welt mach ich alles anders

tags.name: Coming of Age
tags.description: Centers around a character's transition from childhood to adulthood.

tags.name: Isekai
tags.description: Features a character from a modern-day setting being transported into an alternate world and has to adapt to their new surroundings.

tags.name: Rehabilitation
tags.description: Prominently features the recovery of a character who became incapable of social life or work.

tags.name: Magic
tags.description: Prominently features magical elements or the use of magic.

tags.name: Reincarnation
tags.description: Features a character being born again after death, typically as another person or in another world.

tags.name: Polyamorous
tags.description: Features a character who is in a consenting relationship with multiple people at one time.

tags.name: Travel
tags.description: Centers around character(s) moving between places a significant distance apart.

tags.name: Family Life
tags.description: Centers around the activities of a family unit.

tags.name: Male Protagonist
tags.description: Main character is male.

tags.name: Tragedy
tags.description: Centers around tragic events and unhappy endings.

tags.name: Survival
tags.description: Centers around the struggle to live in spite of extreme obstacles.

tags.name: Female Harem
tags.description: Main cast features the protagonist plus several female characters who are romantically interested in them.

tags.name: Ensemble Cast
tags.description: Features a large cast of characters with (almost) equal screen time and importance to the plot.

tags.name: Time Manipulation
tags.description: Prominently features time-traveling or other time-warping phenomena.

tags.name: Gods
tags.description: Prominently features a character of divine or religious nature.

tags.name: Time Skip
tags.description: Features a gap in time used to advance the story.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: Features fourth wall-breaking references to itself or genre tropes.

tags.name: Hikikomori
tags.description: Prominently features a character who withdraws from social life, often seeking extreme isolation.

tags.name: Matriarchy
tags.description: Prominently features a country that is ruled by a Queen or a society that is dominated by female inheritance.

tags.name: Heterosexual
tags.description: Prominently features a romance between a man and a woman, not inherently sexual.

tags.name: Demons
tags.description: Prominently features malevolent otherworldly creatures.

tags.name: Swordplay
tags.description: Prominently features the use of swords in combat.

tags.name: Tsundere
tags.description: Prominently features a character who acts cold and hostile in order to mask warmer emotions.

tags.name: Tomboy
tags.description: Features a girl who exhibits characteristics or behaviors considered in many cultures to be typical of boys.

tags.name: Crossdressing
tags.description: Prominently features a character dressing up as the opposite sex.

tags.name: Elf
tags.description: Prominently features a character who is an elf.

tags.name: Teacher
tags.description: Protagonist is an educator, usually in a school setting.

tags.name: Slavery
tags.description: Prominently features slaves, slavery, or slave trade.

tags.name: School
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a primary or secondary educational institution.

tags.name: Language Barrier
tags.description: A barrier to communication between people who are unable to speak a common language.

tags.name: Otaku Culture
tags.description: Centers around the culture of a fanatical fan-base.

tags.name: Marriage
tags.description: Centers around marriage between two or more characters.

tags.name: Revenge
tags.description: Prominently features a character who aims to exact punishment in a resentful or vindictive manner.

tags.name: Dungeon
tags.description: Prominently features a dungeon environment.

tags.name: Amnesia
tags.description: Prominently features a character(s) with memory loss.

tags.name: Nekomimi
tags.description: Humanoid characters with cat-like features such as cat ears and a tail.

tags.name: Dragons
tags.description: Prominently features mythical reptiles which generally have wings and can breathe fire.

tags.name: Maids
tags.description: Prominently features a character who is a maid.

tags.name: Religion
tags.description: Centers on the belief that humanity is related to supernatural, transcendental, and spiritual elements.

tags.name: Ojou-sama
tags.description: Features a wealthy, high-class, oftentimes stuck up and demanding female character.

tags.name: Desert
tags.description: Prominently features a desert environment.

tags.name: Archery
tags.description: Centers around the sport of archery, or prominently features the use of archery in combat.
